principle: Rhythmic collision through systematic desynchronization of temporal, spatial, and graphic registers that accelerate independently toward structural impossibility, producing intensification without spatial or temporal grounding.

nodes.label: Metric montage with variable unit length
nodes.description: Shot duration operates as rhythmic structure, systematically accelerating from 6.2-second average (exposition) to 1.4-second average (Steps climax) then decelerating to 3.1 seconds (finale), creating a measurable compression-expansion curve across runtime.
evidence: Shot counts per minute quantified across all five acts, ranging from 12 (exposition) to 60+ (Steps climax)
Average shot lengths measured per sequence: 6.2s opening, 2.8s mutiny, 1.4s Steps massacre, 3.1s finale
Steps sequence deploys three distinct metric zones: crowd descent 2-3s, soldier march 1-2s, carriage 0.5-1s at climax
rules: Metric acceleration must desynchronize from temporal expansion
As shot duration halves, facial framing tightens proportionally

nodes.label: Overlapping action temporal expansion
nodes.description: Single diegetic events fragment across multiple shots from different angles, extending screen duration 4.5 to 7 times beyond story time; the technique reads as multi-perspectival intensification rather than repetition only because spatial coherence is withheld.
evidence: Pince-nez breaking: seven shots, 14 seconds of screen time representing roughly 2 seconds of story time, a 7:1 expansion
Carriage descent: 42 shots, 90 seconds of screen time for roughly 20 seconds of diegetic time, a 4.5:1 expansion
rules: Temporal expansion must be masked by spatial incoherence

nodes.label: Tonal and graphic collision montage
nodes.description: Shots organize by visual opposition rather than spatial continuity: binary cuts between extreme grayscale values (80% to 20% luminance) in ABABAB patterns, and compositional diagonals that contradict across cuts (45-degree descending versus 30-degree ascending vectors forming X-patterns).
evidence: Officer confrontation alternates high-key (80%+ luminance) and low-key (20% luminance) in ABABAB pattern across 18 shots with no gradual transition
Twelve documented instances in the Steps sequence where adjacent shot diagonals form an X-pattern when superimposed
rules: Adjacent shots must refuse visual synthesis

nodes.label: Serialized scalar progression of close-ups
nodes.description: Faces advance through fixed scale increments (long shot to extreme close-up) with systematic halving of visible figures per step, synchronizing spatial compression with the temporal compression of metric montage to maintain information density per unit time.
evidence: Mourning sequence progresses long shot crowd, medium shot cluster of 5, medium close-up of 3, close-up of 1, extreme close-up of eyes only
The scalar pattern repeats four times across the harbor sequence with identical intervals
Tightest facial framings coincide with the 1.4-second shot average; return to medium and long shots coincides with the 3.1-second finale deceleration

nodes.label: Vertical spatial stratification
nodes.description: The Steps sequence organizes bodies across six horizontal planes with strict hierarchical positioning: soldiers top plane only, crowd planes 2-5, victims plane 6. The hierarchy is maintained across 170+ shots, making the carriage the only element to traverse the full vertical range.
evidence: Soldiers occupy the top two compositional bands exclusively while the crowd scatters across the lower four across 170+ shots
Spatial hierarchy is maintained until the final 12 shots
The carriage is the sole element that descends through all six planes
rules: Hierarchical plane boundaries maintained across 170+ shots until final breach

nodes.label: 180-degree rule violation as structural principle
nodes.description: Eyeline matches systematically disregard screen direction: sailors and officers both look the same screen direction across cuts, producing spatial impossibility. Not continuity error but a deliberate refusal of spatial coherence that masks temporal manipulation as multi-perspectival viewing.
evidence: Directional eyeline impossibility repeated 8 times in the mutiny sequence
Pince-nez sequence shots show spatially impossible eyeline matches with both parties looking left
rule_violations: 180-degree rule and eyeline match continuity convention

nodes.label: Silent release with no structurally controlled sound
nodes.description: The 1925 release had no sonic dimension under structural control; the temporal logic must function without auditory cues, forcing all metric information into shot duration and graphic rhythm.
evidence: No sonic dimension was structurally controlled in the 1925 release; scores came later (Meisel 1926, Shostakovich reconstruction 1976)
The 16:1 durational contrast ratio within the Steps sequence would be redundant if musical tempo were present

nodes.label: Fabric as kinetic indicator (flags, sails, tarpaulin, clothing)
nodes.description: Moving fabric registers wind and motion against static architecture, supplying kinetic cues that sound would otherwise provide; the fabric-to-rigid-surface ratio shifts from 1:4 (opening) to 3:1 (finale), tracking the metric acceleration.
evidence: The flag occupies 15% of frame area across 22 shots, always in motion, contrasting with static stone steps and ship hull
Fabric-to-rigid ratio increases from 1:4 to 3:1 across the runtime, tracking the 6.2s to 1.4s metric acceleration
Stage 3 notes fabric presence increases in the final act even after its compensatory function becomes redundant
rules: Fabric-to-rigid ratio increases (1:4 to 3:1) as shot duration decreases

nodes.label: Baby carriage descent on the Odessa Steps
nodes.description: The kinetic climax of the Steps sequence: 42 shots and 90 seconds of screen time for roughly 20 seconds of story time, occurring at a decelerated 2.8-second average shot length, slower than surrounding material, and the only element traversing all six vertical planes.
evidence: 42 shots, 90 seconds screen time, roughly 20 seconds diegetic time, a 4.5:1 expansion
Occurs at 2.8-second average shot length within a sequence otherwise averaging 1.4 seconds
Only element to descend through all six horizontal planes of the stratified space
rules: Kinetic climax occurs at decelerated tempo (2.8s average) rather than maximum metric velocity

nodes.label: Pince-nez breaking sequence
nodes.description: The officer's pince-nez breaking fragments into seven shots and 14 seconds of screen time representing roughly 2 seconds of story time, with spatially impossible eyeline matches masking the 7:1 temporal expansion.
evidence: Seven shots, 14 seconds screen time, roughly 2 seconds story time, a 7:1 expansion ratio
The constituent shots show both parties looking the same screen direction, an impossible geometry

nodes.label: Odessa Steps as built-in compositional grid
nodes.description: The step edges divide the frame into 6-8 parallel horizontal bands functioning as a compositional armature; figures are positioned at band intersections, giving the vertical stratification its physical scaffold.
evidence: Horizontal step edges divide the frame into 6-8 parallel bands
Figures are positioned at band intersections, with soldiers confined to the top two bands

edges.rationale: Temporal expansion through overlapping action requires spatial incoherence (180-degree rule violations) to mask the temporal impossibility as multi-perspectival viewing rather than repetition error.
Metric acceleration requires serialized scalar progression to maintain information density per unit time; as shot duration halves, facial framing must tighten proportionally.

Sonic absence forces metric information into visual parameters, making shot duration the sole temporal organizing principle and requiring the 16:1 durational contrast ratios within the Steps sequence.

Graphic collision montage prevents visual synthesis across cuts, which enables metric acceleration to operate as a contradictory vector against temporal expansion without resolving into coherent space-time.

Graphic collision prevents visual synthesis across cuts, which enables temporal expansion to coexist with metric acceleration as unresolved contradictory vectors; remove the register and the others lose their structural antagonist.
As metric velocity increases (shorter shots), fabric-to-rigid surface ratios must increase (1:4 to 3:1) to maintain kinetic information density through visual motion markers.

Metric montage says faster while overlapping action says slower: shots get shorter as moments get longer. These vectors move in opposite directions, and the desynchronization is the productive structural tension the work depends on.

Vertical stratification depends on the steps as built-in compositional armature: the 6-8 horizontal bands defined by step edges supply the plane boundaries that soldiers, crowd, and victims are segregated across.
Vertical spatial stratification must maintain hierarchical boundaries across 170+ shots to make the carriage's transgressive descent through all planes structurally legible as a breach.

The carriage descent is constituted by overlapping action: 42 shots and 90 seconds of screen time for roughly 20 seconds of story time; without the 4.5:1 expansion the descent is an ordinary continuous event.

The kinetic climax occurs at 2.8-second average shot length, slower than the surrounding 1.4-second material, inverting the metric promise that compression equals intensification; the durational logic fails precisely where it should culminate.
The pince-nez sequence is the paradigm instance of overlapping action: seven shots stretching 2 seconds of story time into 14 seconds of screen time.

The sequence reads as a single extended moment from multiple vantages only because its eyeline matches are spatially impossible; with directional coherence the viewer would perceive stuttering repetition.

Scalar progression synchronizes spatial compression with temporal compression: each shot half as long, each frame showing half as many faces, producing exponential intensification of the metric curve.

violated: Metric acceleration must desynchronize from temporal expansion

failure_modes.consequence: If metric montage and overlapping action synchronize their acceleration and expansion rates, the temporal contradiction collapses into simple fast-cutting and the work becomes conventional continuity cinema; the M1-M2 contradicts edge is the load-bearing tension.

If spatial continuity is maintained during overlapping action sequences, temporal expansion becomes legible as repetition error rather than multi-perspectival intensification; M2 and its instances (pince-nez, carriage) lose their warrant.

If graphic collision resolves into visual synthesis, the three measurement systems (metric, temporal, spatial) can unify into coherent space-time and the desynchronization mechanism fails; both M1 and M2 lose the register that keeps their vectors from resolving.

violated: Kinetic climax occurs at decelerated tempo (2.8s average) rather than maximum metric velocity

failure_modes.consequence: If the carriage descent occurs at maximum metric velocity (1.4s average) instead of decelerated tempo (2.8s), the inversion of compression-equals-intensification logic breaks and the kinetic climax flattens into undifferentiated velocity.

violated: Fabric-to-rigid ratio increases (1:4 to 3:1) as shot duration decreases

failure_modes.consequence: If fabric motion markers decrease during metric acceleration instead of increasing to the 3:1 ratio, kinetic information density drops as temporal units compress and the visual rhythm becomes illegible.

Without maintained plane boundaries and the architectural grid supplying them, the carriage's descent through all six planes loses its legibility as transgression; the Steps sequence loses its spatial hierarchy and the descent becomes ordinary movement.

asserted_removal_tests.M1: If removed, the work becomes spatially continuous narrative cinema rather than rhythmically organized collision; the entire temporal architecture collapses and no other mechanism can replace its
asserted_removal_tests.M2: If removed, single-perspective continuity editing replaces multi-angle fragmentation; the expansion ratios that define intensification through temporal impossibility disappear and the work loses its
asserted_removal_tests.M3: If removed, shots organize by spatial logic and continuity rather than visual collision; the lighting alternations and diagonal vector contradictions that create meaning through graphic opposition
asserted_removal_tests.M4: If removed, metric acceleration loses its synchronized spatial compression and information density per unit time drops as shots shorten; the analysis holds it could be replaced by other intensification methods, but the exponential dual-compression effect would be lost.
asserted_removal_tests.M5: If removed, the Steps sequence loses its visual hierarchy and the carriage's transgressive descent through all planes becomes structurally illegible; the mechanism serves the collision montage rather than generating independent logic.
asserted_removal_tests.M6: If removed, overlapping action's temporal impossibility is unmasked: viewers perceive stuttering repetition rather than a single extended moment seen from multiple vantages; the central expansion mechanism fails.
